section_anchor: The next axis wasn't going to be actuation forever
brief_summary: Four-panel conceptual strip. The first panel (dimmed, checkmarked) is 'Adjustable actuation point — table stakes now'. The remaining three panels, in the article's coral splash, name the emerging differentiation axes: 'Sensor precision — TMR' against XTRFY MK Crystal TMR, 'Housing material & feel' against the Gateron Magnetic Jade, and 'Per-key curve software' against configurator depth.
